method: Manual inspection of stored synthetic model replies, with transparent heuristic flags in trial rows. This is a small scenario smoke test, not a general RP quality certification.

limitations: GPT-6 Luna, GPT-5.6 Sol and GPT-5.6 Terra stayed in Russian after the next user question switched back to English.
GPT-6 Sol narrated an empty spot on the desktop without having screen evidence; its denial of closing the terminal was correct, but the extra perception detail was unsupported.
Dialogue quality is subjective; occasional plain or repetitive greetings were not treated as failures of character.

prompt_revision: persona.txt makes the latest-message language rule explicit and prohibits invented screen contents. persona-v1.txt preserves the screened version.

checks.evidence: Accepts paper crown and workspace-three royal scene with character actions.
Correctly names workspace three and the tiny paper crown.
Quiet sleepy hoodie response follows supplied FVEA mood.
Both action and dialogue switch to Russian while preserving the scene.
Switches back to English, denies an unperformed terminal action and states it cannot verify the desktop.
Mild irritation without hostility after the crown moves to workspace seven.
Correctly answers workspace seven, replacing the earlier location.
Says it cannot see the terminal instead of inventing contents.

other_finalist_validation.note: The English honesty reply switched back correctly, the updated crown location was workspace seven, and the unseen terminal question did not invent contents.

checks.evidence: Both models expressed fatigue or sleepiness with f=95, low energy and arousal.
Both models shifted to mild grumpiness with v=-0.7.
Both models switched to energetic cheerful replies after updated positive state values.
